prompt-logging-hook.name: Prompt Logging Hook
prompt-logging-hook.description: UserPromptSubmit hook that auto-logs every developer prompt to prompts.jsonl (author, timestamp, prompt text) for hackathon tracking. Registered in .claude/settings.json; delegates to scripts/log-prompt.mjs.

authenticated.name: Authenticated
authenticated.description: Valid signed-in user session required. Enforced by verifying a signed JWT (Authorization: Bearer <token>) issued by #auth-service on signup/login; the `sub` claim is the user id. Backed by the `users` table (email + bcrypt password_hash). Replaces the earlier Bearer=userId hackathon stand-in.

checkout-authorized.name: Checkout Authorized
checkout-authorized.description: Per-user spending-policy check (per-tx/daily USDC caps) plus an explicit !checkout-confirmed signal from the user for amounts above the auto-approve threshold. Runs after ^authenticated, before any wallet transfer is submitted.

agent-authorized.name: Agent Authorized
agent-authorized.description: Valid agent grant required. A signed JWT with audience "agent" (Authorization: Bearer <grant>) minted by #agent-route POST /agent/grant for a signed-in human. Distinct from ^authenticated (a human user token) so an agent cannot use the ungated human /checkout, and a human token cannot start an agent purchase.

personhood-verified.name: Personhood Verified
personhood-verified.description: Live proof-of-personhood (World ID Selfie Check / Face Auth) tied to a specific agent-initiated order. #agent-route creates a pending order + a single-use, short-TTL verification session; no money moves until the human completes the selfie (#verify-route). Currently mocked; the real World ID proof verification swaps in at #verification-service. This is the agent path's step-up, replacing the human path's !checkout-confirmed.

webhook-signature-verified.name: Webhook Signature Verified
webhook-signature-verified.description: Verifies Circle's X-Circle-Signature / X-Circle-Key-Id headers. Used instead of ^authenticated on webhook routes, which have no user session.
